Title: Updates to network recommendations in Azure Security Center

Body.Content: Azure Security Center (ASC) has launched new networking recommendations and improved some existing ones. Now, using Security Center ensures even greater networking protection for your resources. For more information, see the Network Recommendations section in the Azure Security Center documentation.
